ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_ATM] AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer
AS
(
SELECT
BAC.CLT_ID AS AtmCustomerId
,BAC.CLT_CIF_NUMBER AS RelatedCustomerId
,'Previous Card' AS RelationshipTypeId
,BAC.CLT_CREATED_TS  AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS RelatedPaymentCardNote
,BAC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'ATM' AS SourceSystemCode
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS [InsertDttm]
FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENT BAC
WHERE  BAC.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer FROM TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer;


--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,AtmCustomerId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,RelatedCustomerId)
)) HASHROW, AtmCustomerId, RelatedCustomerId, RelationshipTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer 
),


TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,AtmCustomerId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,RelatedCustomerId)
)) HASHROW, AtmCustomerId, RelatedCustomerId, RelationshipTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer
WHERE PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31' AND SourceSystemCode = 'ATM'
),

TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.AtmCustomerId, TGT.AtmCustomerId) AS AtmCustomerId
,ISNULL(SRC.RelatedCustomerId, TGT.RelatedCustomerId) AS RelatedCustomerId
,ISNULL(SRC.RelationshipTypeId, TGT.RelationshipTypeId) AS RelationshipTypeId
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode, TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <>  TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_TGT TGT
ON SRC.AtmCustomerId = TGT.AtmCustomerId
AND SRC.RelatedCustomerId = TGT.RelatedCustomerId
AND SRC.RelationshipTypeId = TGT.RelationshipTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
AtmCustomerId = SRC.AtmCustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId = SRC.RelatedCustomerId
,RelationshipTypeId = SRC.RelationshipTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp
,RelatedPaymentCardNote = SRC.RelatedPaymentCardNote
FROM BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.AtmCustomerId = TGT.AtmCustomerId 
AND DELTA.RelatedCustomerId = TGT.RelatedCustomerId 
AND DELTA.RelationshipTypeId = TGT.RelationshipTypeId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer SRC 
ON SRC.AtmCustomerId = TGT.AtmCustomerId
AND SRC.RelatedCustomerId = TGT.RelatedCustomerId
AND SRC.RelationshipTypeId = TGT.RelationshipTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '9999-12-31';


--INSERT TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer
(
AtmCustomerId
,RelatedCustomerId
,RelationshipTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,RelatedPaymentCardNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
SRC.AtmCustomerId
,SRC.RelatedCustomerId
,SRC.RelationshipTypeId
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp
,SRC.RelatedPaymentCardNote
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,'ATM' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_DELTA DELTA	 
ON  DELTA.AtmCustomerId = SRC.AtmCustomerId 
AND DELTA.RelatedCustomerId = SRC.RelatedCustomerId
AND DELTA.RelationshipTypeId = SRC.RelationshipTypeId 
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer_DELTA;


END
